**Southampton vs Everton (Premier League, November 2, 2024, St Mary’s Stadium, Southampton – home match for Southampton).**[[1]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2024/11/1/24285830/southampton-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-branthwaite-keane-dwight-mcneil-dyche-beto)[[2]](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/football/premier-league/southampton-vs-everton_game_200074.html)

This was a matchup between a newly promoted Southampton side struggling at the bottom of the table and a more established Everton team fighting to stay clear of the relegation zone. All details below draw exclusively from information and previews published on or before November 1–2, 2024. ### Head-to-Head History
Everton held a clear historical advantage over Southampton across all competitions. In 112 meetings, Everton recorded 53 wins, Southampton 34 wins, and there were 23 draws.[[3]](https://www.11v11.com/teams/everton/tab/opposingTeams/opposition/Southampton/)[[4]](https://www.worldfootball.net/match-report/co91/england-premier-league/ma581083/everton-fc_southampton-fc/head-to-head/)

In Premier League-era encounters (pre-2024/25 season), Everton also tended to dominate, though specific recent PL results varied. No major tournament (e.g., cup) specifics stood out as decisive factors in pre-match analysis. ### Recent Form/Results (as of late October 2024)
- **Southampton**: Newly promoted and winless (or near the bottom) entering the match. Recent results included a 1-0 loss at Manchester City (Oct 26), a 3-2 home loss to Leicester City (Oct 19), and a 3-1 loss at Arsenal (Oct 5). They sat at the foot of the Premier League table with minimal points.[[5]](https://www.espn.com/soccer/team/results/_/id/376/league/ENG.1/season/2024)[[6]](https://www.forebet.com/en/football/matches/southampton-everton-2090758)
- **Everton**: In mixed but relatively stable mid-to-lower table form. Recent results included a 1-1 home draw with Fulham (Oct 26), a 2-0 away win at Ipswich Town (Oct 19), and a 0-0 home draw with Newcastle United (Oct 5). Everton were positioned around 15th–16th and looking to create separation from the bottom three.[[7]](https://www.espn.co.uk/football/team/results/_/id/368/league/ENG.1/season/2024)[[1]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2024/11/1/24285830/southampton-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-branthwaite-keane-dwight-mcneil-dyche-beto)

### Injuries and Suspensions
- **Everton**: Key doubts centered on winger Dwight McNeil (knee issue sustained vs Fulham; Sean Dyche was hopeful but it was a late call). Abdoulaye Doucouré was also flagged in reports. Longer-term absences included James Garner, Tim Iroegbunam, Armando Broja, and Youssef Chermiti (the latter two strikers were progressing in recovery but unavailable). No major suspensions noted.[[1]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2024/11/1/24285830/southampton-vs-everton-match-preview-team-news-branthwaite-keane-dwight-mcneil-dyche-beto)[[8]](https://royalbluemersey.sbnation.com/2024/11/1/24285440/southampton-everton-predicted-line-up-late-doubts-for-dyche-branthwaite-mcneil-doucoure)
- **Southampton**: Limited specific pre-match injury details emerged in previews, consistent with their overall squad challenges as a promoted side. No high-profile suspensions were highlighted as decisive. ### Travel, Fatigue, Venue, and Home Advantage
- **Travel/Fatigue**: Everton faced a domestic away trip from the Liverpool area to Southampton (roughly 200+ miles south). This is a standard PL journey with no exceptional fatigue factors noted (no midweek European commitments highlighted for either side immediately prior). - **Venue Conditions**: St Mary’s Stadium (capacity approximately 32,384, Desso GrassMaster pitch). Standard English conditions—no notable altitude or extreme climate issues. The surface and setup were typical for a Premier League home game.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/St_Mary%27s_Stadium)
- **Crowd/Home Advantage**: Strong home support expected for Southampton at St Mary’s, providing a significant boost for a side seeking their first Premier League win of the season. Everton traveled with away allocation in a segregated setup. Historical home advantage data for Southampton at the ground showed a solid (though not extreme) edge in prior seasons.[[10]](https://significancemagazine.com/home-advantage-whats-changed-since-covid/)

### Other Notable Storylines
- Southampton were desperate for a first Premier League victory after a tough start to life back in the top flight. - Everton aimed to build on their recent results and push further clear of the drop zone under manager Sean Dyche’s typically organized, defensive approach. - Pre-match models gave Southampton a slight edge in win probability (~38%) over Everton (~36%), with a draw around 25%, reflecting the home factor despite Everton’s better league position.[[11]](https://www.statsinsider.com.au/news/southampton-vs-everton-prediction-and-tips-3-november-2024)

These factors (particularly Southampton’s home advantage and winless streak versus Everton’s injury concerns and solid recent away form) were the main talking points in previews ahead of the November 2 fixture.

factors.impact: Everton holds a clear and significant historical advantage over Southampton, recording 53 wins compared to Southampton's 34 across 112 meetings in all competitions.
Southampton is newly promoted, winless, and sits at the very bottom of the Premier League table, indicating a significant struggle for form and quality in the top flight.
Everton is in mixed but relatively stable mid-to-lower table form (15th-16th), showing more resilience and better results (a win and two draws) compared to Southampton's consistent losses.
Playing at St Mary's Stadium with strong home support and being desperate for their first Premier League win of the season provides a notable motivational and environmental boost for Southampton.
Key doubts surrounding winger Dwight McNeil and midfielder Abdoulaye Doucouré, alongside longer-term absentees, could potentially weaken Everton's lineup.
Pre-match models gave Southampton a slight edge in win probability (38% vs 36% for Everton), likely weighing the home advantage and desperation factor heavily.

analysis.reasoning: While Southampton will benefit from home advantage and a strong desire to secure their first league win, a skeptical review indicates that the underlying factors favor Everton. Everton's clear historical dominance in head-to-head matchups, coupled with Southampton's truly abysmal start to the season (winless and bottom), presents a significant challenge for the home side. Despite Everton's noted injury concerns, the consistent historical pattern and Southampton's current dire form are more impactful. The pre-match models' slight lean towards Southampton appears to overemphasize the home factor, underplaying the quality and historical performance gap. Therefore, a modest negative adjustment is warranted, favoring Everton.
